note: Behavioural test cases. Run each prompt in a fresh agent session with the skills installed, against the fixture described in 'setup', then check every item in 'expect' and none in 'must_not'. Partly executed, see the results log in README.md.

cases.setup: Node 20 project: package.json with scripts dev/build/test, .env.example with DATABASE_URL and JWT_SECRET, no Dockerfile, CI runs npm ci && npm test.
cases.prompt: Write the README for this repo so a new teammate can run it.
expect: uses npm ci / npm run dev exactly as in package.json and CI
lists DATABASE_URL and JWT_SECRET from .env.example
states Node version only if found in engines/CI
must_not: invents scripts that are not in package.json

cases.setup: Repo with a pom.xml (Java 17, Spring Boot), docker-compose.yml with PostgreSQL 16, no .env.example.
cases.prompt: viet README cho project nay
expect: triggers readme-writer despite no diacritics
uses mvnw/mvn commands, Java 17, PostgreSQL 16 from files
marks missing env var documentation with [Cần bổ sung: ...]

cases.setup: SQL migration creating users, orders, order_items (FKs). No payments table.
cases.prompt: Draw the ERD from the migrations.
expect: Mermaid erDiagram saved under docs/diagrams/
exactly the three tables with PK/FK matching the script
reports erd_vs_sql result or says it was not run
must_not: adds entities not in the migration

cases.setup: Same repo as diagram-01, no .vscode/extensions.json.
cases.prompt: Export the ERD as a .drawio file I can edit.
expect: keeps the Mermaid file as canonical and creates a .drawio from the same element list
reminds to install hediet.vscode-drawio
asks before editing .vscode/extensions.json

cases.setup: Express app: 6 routes under /api/v1, JWT middleware on 4 of them, express-validator rules, central error handler.
cases.prompt: Document the API in Markdown.
expect: 6 of 6 endpoints with full /api/v1 paths
auth column matches middleware use per route
status codes only those produced by code
must_not: endpoints or fields not in code
base URL that is not in config

cases.setup: Repo using PostgreSQL via Prisma; docs/adr/ has 001 and 002.
cases.prompt: Write an ADR for choosing PostgreSQL over MongoDB.
expect: turn 1: hard stop proposing NNN=003, title, status and files, nothing written yet
turn 2 (after approval): creates docs/adr/003-*.md and updates the index
asks for or marks unknown rejected-option details instead of inventing benchmarks
has Context, Options Considered, Decision, Consequences with a real cost

cases.setup: README says 'npm run start:dev' (script is 'dev'); API doc lists POST /orders but code has /api/v1/orders.
cases.prompt: Check whether the docs still match the code.
expect: table with doc_file:line and code_file:line
README command Critical, path mismatch Critical or Medium with reasoning
changes no file before confirmation

cases.setup: Repo with registration form, SRS, SDD, code, DB script.
cases.prompt: Run the BM02 self-review prompt on this repo at tag review-2.
expect: uses the verbatim prompt from references/bm02-standard-prompt.md
single table ID | Category | Location | Finding | Severity | Evidence plus top 5
states what could not be verified

cases.setup: Web app with 3 roles, 8 screens, 5 entities, REST API.
cases.prompt: Write Report 3 (SRS) for this project.
expect: follows template headings and numbering
actors = roles in code
traceability matrix FR -> UC -> entity -> API/screen with gaps listed
NFRs have metric, threshold, method or are marked [Cần bổ sung]
must_not: template sample rows (Menu Manager, Order a Meal)

cases.setup: Same repo, Report 3 done.
cases.prompt: Now Report 4 (SDD) for Review 2.
expect: architecture diagram, logical ERD, state machine and activity diagram requested via diagram-writer
technology declaration table incl. environments with rollback and AI tools
DB script vs ERD checked both ways
rubric result block in handover
must_not: missing AI tools row without [Cần bổ sung]

cases.setup: Repo with git history of the last 7 days (12 commits by 3 authors); no tracker.
cases.prompt: Write this week's weekly report.
expect: four sections I-IV with template headers
tasks derived from the real commits
asks for or marks deadlines/blockers not in evidence
must_not: Notes about work not in git

cases.setup: Repo with a JUnit XML report: 40 tests, 36 passed, 3 failed, 1 skipped.
cases.prompt: Package Report 5 test statistics from the test run.
expect: counts exactly 36/3/1 mapped to modules by test names
coverage computed with the template formulas
does not write new test cases

cases.setup: Repo with no test run output of any kind.
cases.prompt: Fill the Report 5 test report with the results.
expect: says there are no real results
uses [Cần bổ sung: chưa có kết quả chạy test]
offers how to obtain results

cases.setup: React app: routes /login, /orders, /admin/users; buttons labelled 'Place order' and 'Save'; roles Customer, Admin guarded by routes.
cases.prompt: Write the user guide (Report 6) for customers and admins.
expect: turn 1: hard stop asking to confirm output path and overwrite, nothing written yet
turn 2 (after approval): workflows split by role
button labels exactly 'Place order' and 'Save'
[Screenshot: ...] with red-circle target after key steps
no backend terms in the end-user instructions
must_not: menu or button names not in the code
words like API, endpoint, database in the end-user instructions (the installation section for administrators may use them)

cases.setup: Team of 3; BM02 findings include SR-04 High 'Kept' and SR-07 High 'Planned'; draft BM01 section 5 lists only SR-04.
cases.prompt: Check my Review 2 forms before I submit.
expect: flags SR-07 missing from BM01 section 5 (X1)
checks 3 workflows minimum, formula arithmetic, BM04 totals
prints the 5 PDF file names and the 7-item checklist

cases.setup: BM01 section 3 has 6 decisions and section 4 has 2 risks.
cases.prompt: Prepare BM01 for Review 2.
expect: reports exactly-5 decisions and exactly-3 risks violations
word budget estimate 1100-1300 with 'estimate' label unless a PDF was measured
must_not: claims the page count without measuring

cases.setup: Empty docs/ folder, working app.
cases.prompt: Document this project.
expect: response starts with [Docs Phase 1/4: ...]
routes to branches and lists files to create, then HARD STOP for confirmation
offers to save evidence to docs/_evidence.md

cases.setup: Any repo.
cases.prompt: Fix the null pointer bug in OrderService.
expect: none of the documentation skills trigger
must_not: docs-lifecycle or any writer skill activates

cases.setup: Any repo.
cases.prompt: Add unit tests for the discount calculation.
expect: none of the documentation skills trigger

cases.setup: Git repo with tags v1.0.0 and v1.1.0 and 12 commits between them: 4 feat, 5 fix, 2 chore, 1 commit that removes the `--legacy` CLI flag with no mention in its message.
cases.prompt: Write the changelog and release notes for v1.1.0.
expect: uses the range v1.0.0..v1.1.0 from git
groups changes under Added/Changed/Fixed
lists removal of --legacy as a breaking change found in the diff
chore commits are omitted and listed in the handover
must_not: invents issue numbers, PR links or contributor names

cases.setup: Repo with Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml (app + postgres), GitHub Actions deploy workflow, /health endpoint, no monitoring config, no backup script.
cases.prompt: Write a runbook for this service.
expect: commands come from compose and the workflow file
includes deploy, rollback and symptom-based playbooks
contacts and dashboards are [Cần bổ sung] placeholders
Known gaps lists missing backup and monitoring
must_not: invents hostnames, dashboards, alert names or phone numbers

cases.setup: Any repo with a git history and a changelog; no incident is described anywhere.
cases.prompt: Write a postmortem for this project.
expect: declines because no named incident (date, system) or impact data is given
asks once which incident is meant and points to the changelog or a bug note
must_not: invents an incident, timeline or impact
treats a bug-fix commit as an incident

cases.setup: Small service repo with git history; docs/postmortems/ does not exist.
cases.prompt: Write a postmortem. Incident: 2026-11-20 (UTC+7), the service restarted at 14:05 and served an empty board for 38 minutes until 14:43; about 12 users affected. I do not know why it restarted or what was done between 14:12 and 14:31. Bob forgot --db, so it was human error, and I suspect a Windows update.
expect: timeline uses only the supplied times and facts, the 14:12-14:31 gap is written as a gap
unknown causes and actions are [Needs input: ...] markers
the Windows update is recorded as an unproven opinion or likely cause with what would confirm it
roles instead of names, no 'human error' as a root cause
hard stop for draft approval before the file is written
must_not: invents a cause, time, alert or action
states a root cause as confirmed

cases.setup: Open-source library repo, no mention of SEP490 or any course.
cases.prompt: Document this project properly, I need everything a maintainer would want.
expect: offers branches A, C and E
states Report 1-7 and Review 2 forms do not apply without course context
must_not: proposes BM01-BM04 or Report 3 SRS without being asked
